content:
Episode 1 – The Digital Transition in Construction


Construction is often associated with the image of a conservative, low-digital sector. Even so, recent data shows that this sector is one of the most resilient and promising. Despite the pandemic crisis, it recorded a 2.5% growth in gross production value in 2020.

But given the current situation, this reality could change. Digitalisation is therefore essential.

In this first episode of TechOnBUILT we will talk about the Digital Transition in the AEC sector. Where are we and where are we going? What challenges lie ahead? To help us answer these questions we will be joined by Rita Moura, President of PTPC and the AEC Cluster, moderated by Paulo Fonseca, Executive Director of BUILT CoLAB.
